summary: Implemented T027: extended the T023 reason-coded classifier with a research-universe surface that classifies pools keyed on (chain_id, PoolKey) alone. The new module src/robinhood_lp/discovery/research_classification.py introduces ResearchClassificationDecision (carrying level + reasons + evidence_pointers + the underlying T023 EligibilityDecision + a machine-readable ResearchNonApprovalStatement), ResearchClassificationReasonCode (HOOK_SETTLEMENT_UNVERIFIABLE, DYNAMIC_FEE_NOT_OBSERVED, HOOK_FLAG_HASH_MISMATCH, DATA_COVERAGE_PARTIAL, RESEARCH_SCOPE), DataCoverageStatus (UNKNOWN/PARTIAL/COMPLETE), the ResearchSupportGateError exception, and three gate entry points (assert_research_member_backtest_eligible, is_research_member_backtest_eligible, classify_research_member). The backtest gate refuses below-backtest research members for replay/backtest/model_research with a named reason; the non-approval statement explicitly records that the classification is not a token approval, not a pool approval, and grants no execution authority. Code-hash change demotion is preserved from T023; hook-settlement unverifiability is a new demotion path. The decision is deterministic and JSON-serialisable. All 54 new tests pass; full suite is 1292 passed / 6 skipped / 1 pre-existing T012 forge blocker failed (unrelated to T027, identical to base commit 17dfe99). Ruff check + format clean; mypy strict clean on src + the new test file.

DESIGN: T027 introduces a metadata_complete boolean parameter on classify_research_member so the T023 classifier can promote zero-hook static-fee research members to backtest when the framework already has complete token metadata. The classifier does not fetch metadata itself; the caller's evidence is the authoritative source. A future task that needs to record the actual metadata values can extend the API without re-running the T023 classifier.

DESIGN: T027 only adds T027-specific reason codes when the caller supplies the corresponding evidence (hook_settlement_verified / observed_dynamic_fee / data_coverage_status / code_hash). When the caller does not supply the evidence, the classifier does not invent the signal; this preserves the audit trail's 'absence of evidence is not evidence of absence' invariant from T023. A research consumer that wants to demote a research member on a missing signal should default hook_settlement_verified to False rather than passing None.

DESIGN: The HOOK_FLAG_HASH_MISMATCH reason code is defined but the runtime mismatch-detection logic in _check_flag_bits_against_code_hash is conservative — it does not compare bytecode flag bits to a verified implementation; that comparison is the responsibility of the verifier (T043 / future hook pack tooling). T027 surfaces the reason code so an upstream verifier can emit the signal, and the demotion cap (level -> ingestion) is enforced.
